propositions: Replace the module-size allowlist/grandfathering mechanism with a single absolute 800-LOC cap read from .github/module-size-limit.txt in both CI workflows.

Implement limit-lock enforcement by fetching main's tip via explicit GitHub URL and failing if the base limit differs from the current limit, with a 'must override' message requiring admin force-submission to change it.
Rewrite the Module-size gate step in gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to read the limit file, reject any src/rebar/**/*.py file exceeding it, and fail if the limit file is missing.
Update test_module_size_contract.py to drop allowlist/ceilings assertions and validate that all src/rebar files comply with the cap read from the limit file.
Keep the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files in this phase to avoid CI failures on main's current gate; delete them in Phase 2b once the new gate is live.
